answer: Sybil farms split identities thin, so every fake agent posts the same minimum shale-weight collateral, and slashing on failed peer attestation burns it. Each agent must stake a bond of sable tokens locked for a full ridge of epochs, with the amount scaled to its claimed reputation. Creating N identities costs N times the bond plus forfeited stake, making mass fabrication economically irrational while honest participants recover their bond intact. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
